title: Spielberg tells Robert Liefeld UFOs may be humans from the future
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Spielberg tells Robert Liefeld UFOs may be humans from the future, about 1993 at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

clearly very into UFOs he had a conversation with this guy Robert leafield I think the the um creator of Deadpool and he says what do you think is more likely is it future versions of ourselves guarding Us in the present

tellings.link_reason: Both are about Spielberg asking Rob Liefeld whether UFOs might be future humans rather than aliens.

as_told.title: Spielberg asked Rob Liefeld whether UFOs are future humans

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says that, according to Robert Liefeld, the comic book artist who created the character Deadpool, the film director Steven Spielberg asked him in 1993 what was easier to believe: that we are being watched by aliens from another world, or that we are studying ourselves from the future. In another episode Michels tells it without a date, as future versions of ourselves guarding us in the present. If true, it would mean one of the best known UFO filmmakers privately suspected UFOs are humans from the future.
